description:
Dear Research Team,

Please compile a collection of BBC News articles published between January 1 2023 and January 31 2023 that focus on the topics of climate change, renewable energy, and carbon neutral initiatives. The resulting set should be limited to pieces from the specified source and timeframe, and each article should be clearly tagged with one or more of the three keywords mentioned.

Thank you for handling this request.
